T: Yes, the news is now open 24 hours. So is the kitchen.
D: Ron Burgundy and his old news team land jobs at the first 24-hour news channel in New York.
P: Serve the snacks when the news team gets back together.
S: Floured fried wings tossed in a honey, sriracha and soy glaze
Sticky fried chicken wings tossed in a sweet and spicy glaze, which Champ swears are chicken this time.
Panko crumbed white fish bites with lemon and tartare sauce
Crumbed white fish bites fried golden, with lemon and a quick tartare, from Ron's lighthouse days.
M: Garlic butter sirloin with oven fries and creamed spinach
New York strip steaks seared hard in a cast-iron pan with garlic butter, sliced and served with fries and creamed spinach.
Champ Kind's Chicken of the Cave
Champ swears it's chicken. It's chicken here, we checked

Buttermilk fried chicken with hot honey, pickles and a crunchy cabbage slaw. Soak the chicken in the buttermilk with half the paprika and salt for at least 20 minutes. Mix the flour with the rest of the paprika, the garlic powder and salt. Toss the chicken in it, pressing to coat. Heat the oil to 170C and fry in batches for 6 to 7 minutes until deep golden and cooked through. Drain on a rack. Warm the honey with the chilli flakes. Toss the shredded cabbage with the mayonnaise and salt and serve with the chicken, hot honey and pickles.
W: Warm dark chocolate and cream fondue for dipping strawberries
Dark chocolate melted with cream for dipping strawberries, marshmallows and chunks of sponge, very seventies, very Ron.
K: Blended Scotch, sweet vermouth and bitters, stirred and chilled

Blended Scotch stirred with sweet vermouth and aromatic bitters until icy, strained into a chilled coupe with a brandied cherry. Stays classy. Chill 4 coupes in the freezer. For each drink, fill a mixing glass with ice and add 60ml blended Scotch, 25ml sweet vermouth and 2 dashes of aromatic bitters. Stir for 30 seconds until very cold. Strain into the chilled coupe and drop in a brandied or maraschino cherry. Twist a strip of orange peel over the top and discard it.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the glaze up to 3 days ahead and keep it in the fridge; fry the wings just before serving

steps.text: Toss the chicken wings in the flour seasoned with paprika, garlic powder and salt.

veg.n: King oyster of the Cave wings
veg.make_ahead: Shred the king oyster mushrooms up to 1 day ahead and keep them covered in the fridge; make the honey sriracha glaze up to 3 days ahead. Batter and fry on the night.

steps.text: Halve the king oyster mushrooms lengthways and shred them with a fork into thick strips.
Whisk the flour, smoked paprika, garlic powder and salt with the cold water into a thick batter.
Heat the vegetable oil to 175C in a deep heavy pot.
Dip the mushroom strips in the batter and fry in batches for 5 minutes until golden and crisp, then drain.
Simmer the honey, sriracha and soy for 4 minutes until glossy and toss the fried mushrooms through.

dishes.make_ahead: Crumb up to 3 hours ahead and keep chilled; fry just before serving

steps.text: Cut the white fish into bite-size pieces.
Roll in the flour, the beaten eggs, then the panko and fry in the vegetable oil at 180C for 3 minutes until golden.
Serve with lemon wedges and the tartare sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Press and cut the tofu up to 1 day ahead; crumb and fry just before serving

steps.text: Press the firm tofu dry in paper towel and cut into bite-size pieces.
Roll in the flour mixed with the crumbled nori and salt, then the beaten eggs, then the panko, and fry in the vegetable oil at 180C for 3 minutes until golden.
Serve with lemon wedges and the tartare sauce.

Finish in the oven at 200C until tender.

steps.text: Brew the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, remove them and cool. Chill the coupes in the freezer while it cools.
For each drink, fill a mixing glass with ice and add 60ml of the tea, 25ml of the grape juice, a drop of vanilla and a strip of orange zest.
Stir for 30 seconds until very cold.

s.note: Floured fried wings tossed in a honey, sriracha and soy glaze
s.how: Toss 1.2kg chicken wings in 150g flour seasoned with paprika, garlic powder and salt. Fry at 175C for 10 minutes until golden and cooked through. Simmer 100ml honey, 3 tbsp sriracha and 2 tbsp soy until glossy and toss the wings through.

s.note: Panko crumbed white fish bites with lemon and tartare sauce
s.how: Cut 500g white fish into bite-size pieces. Roll in 50g flour, 2 beaten eggs, then 100g panko and fry at 180C for 3 minutes until golden. Serve with lemon wedges and 150g tartare sauce.

m.note: Garlic butter sirloin with oven fries and creamed spinach
m.how: Season 4 sirloin steaks and sear in a very hot pan for 3 minutes a side, then baste with 50g butter and 2 crushed garlic cloves. Rest 5 minutes. Serve with 1kg oven fries and 400g spinach wilted with 100ml cream.

w.note: Warm dark chocolate and cream fondue for dipping strawberries
w.how: Melt 250g dark chocolate with 200ml cream and a pinch of salt over low heat, stirring until smooth. Pour into a warm bowl and serve with 250g strawberries, 150g marshmallows and a cut-up sponge cake for dipping.

d.note: Blended Scotch, sweet vermouth and bitters, stirred and chilled
d.how: Chill 4 coupes in the freezer. For each drink, fill a mixing glass with ice and add 60ml blended Scotch, 25ml sweet vermouth and 2 dashes of aromatic bitters. Stir for 30 seconds until very cold. Strain into the chilled coupe and drop in a brandied or maraschino cherry. Twist a strip of orange peel over the top and discard it.
